## The problem

Requests arrived through email and chat in different formats, so each one had to be retyped into a tracker by hand. Status was hard to see and tasks slipped.

## What I built

A structured intake form in Microsoft Forms feeds Power Automate flows that create and route Azure DevOps work items and post updates to Teams. Every request gets the same fields, an owner and a visible status.
